reason: Lookalike plan L2b (the E1 r2c GC finding's cause): the Storage panel's lookalike report (web/workspace/api.ts lookalikeGroups) reads the entries' byNfc index by values in fixed pages, each full page's trailing group by count() and a value cursor advanced past its rows in hand, instead of a key cursor whose per-row key strings cost the page a ~100 ms collection; plus its test-only hook (inert unless a test page sets it). And (L2b r2 code, A4) usage() counts from its whole-store read and lets it go before the walk. api.ts is bundled into the CLI, so cli/pyjs.cjs grows by the new walk, the hook and the reorder (measured against master 4efc0707 with bun 1.4.4).
